content.text: {"class": "TEST_CODE_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The release notes for 4.18.0 document a deliberate product change — the #promo-code input was intentionally replaced by [data-testid=\"coupon-input\"] and page objects were explicitly told to update — and the browser log confirms the loaded build is 4.18.0, so the deployed build is the intended one. Under the stale-test rule, a test left un-updated after a deliberate, changelog-documented product change is a wrong test, and the locator in CheckoutPage.enterPromoCode still targets the removed selector. That makes this a test-side locator defect rather than a product defect or environment drift."}
